description:
Group organisers keep asking for meals in the quote instead of sorting them out with the hotel afterwards. We start with breakfast; half board follows next quarter (HOT-531).

Subtasks:
- HOT-532 Breakfast on quotes
- HOT-531 Half board on quotes

comments.author: liam-dev
comments.body: Question on HOT-532: it says a breakfast flag per room line. Is that what we want, or should breakfast be chosen once for the whole quote?

comments.author: maria-pm
comments.body: Decision from the call with revenue and the PMS team: the meal plan is one choice for the whole quote, never per room line. Hotels won't serve breakfast to half a group, and the PMS takes the meal plan once per booking, not per room. Model it as a single field on the quote, `mealPlan: "none" | "breakfast" | "half-board"`, so half board is a new value next quarter and not a new field. All subtasks of this story follow this; I'll update HOT-532.
